The climate in Tromsø

Tromsø is about 16 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 17°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −9°C. Around 1370 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in January (about 134 mm).

Best time to visit Tromsø

The most pleasant weather in Tromsø is usually in July and August: average highs are between 16°C and 17°C, with up to 18 days of rain a month. In January, February, March, November and December nights are frosty (below −3°C on average) and snow is common.
